description: Machine-checkable index of the UX implementation matrix (IMPLEMENTATION_MATRIX.md) — the UX analog of the model test corpus (docs/test-corpus/). Trace slices and scenarios are tagged to a workset with a pending/active activation status, so 'tests <-> work areas, progressively activated' is uniform across model (test-corpus) and UX. The W005 walking skeleton activates the first thin slice (scenarios S1-S3, S14 and the minimal end-to-end slices); everything else flips pending->active as its workset lands. Validated by tools/validate-ux-matrix.ps1.
